headline: GOLDGROUP ABSORBS GOLD RESOURCE TODAY — US$372M Mexico Multi-Mine Play Lists as 'GORO' on NYSE American July 20
snippet: Goldgroup Mining and Gold Resource Corporation are completing their US$372 million business combination today (July 17) — creating a multi-mine, Mexico-focused precious metals producer spanning the Cerro Prieto and San Francisco mines in Sonora, the Don David mine in Oaxaca, and the Back Forty project in Michigan. The combined company will trade on NYSE American under the ticker symbol 'GORO' prior to market open on July 20, following Goldgroup's 4:1 share consolidation; GRC shares delist from NYSE American concurrent with closing.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER BLASTS 472.8m AT 0.40% CuEq — 304.8m High-Grade Core at Thira Porphyry Discovery, Central BC (TSXV:VCU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Vizsla Copper Corp.
snippet: Vizsla Copper (TSXV: VCU) released Phase 1 spring 2026 results from its Thira porphyry discovery at the Poplar Project in central British Columbia, with drill hole TH26-154 returning 472.8 metres at 0.40% copper equivalent from 13.2 metres downhole — including a 304.8-metre high-grade core at 0.48% CuEq. The combined intercept length rivals the widest in B.C.'s active porphyry pipeline and, announced the same week copper fell below $6.20/lb on Iran war fears, positions Thira as a bulk-tonnage discovery for Phase 2 planning.

headline: SILVER AT 8-MONTH LOWS, $55.78 — Down 7% This Week as Iran Strikes Fuel Rate Hike Bets; Gold Stalls Below $4,000
snippet: Silver fell to its lowest level in eight months on July 17, 2026 — settling around $55.78 per ounce and on track for a 7%-plus weekly loss — as US-Iran airstrikes kept oil prices elevated, reviving fears of sustained inflation and Federal Reserve rate hikes that compress both industrial and precious metals demand. Gold held just below $4,000 at session close; traders are pricing roughly a 51% probability of a September rate increase, even as June CPI data effectively ruled out a July hike and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his price-stability commitment.

headline: PERSEUS LOCKS IN $34M YAOURE DRILL PUSH — 123km Planned; Open Pit Running 24% Above Reserve Model (ASX/TSX:PRU)
snippet: Perseus Mining (ASX/TSX: PRU) committed $34 million in FY27 capital to 123 kilometres of resource definition, geotechnical, and metallurgical drilling at its Yaouré Gold Mine in Côte d'Ivoire, disclosing that open-pit drilling over the trailing six months identified 24% more contained metal than the Reserve model and that the CMA underground project hit a development record of 1,598 metres in the March 2026 quarter. Yaouré has achieved a 76% Ore Reserve replacement rate since first production, extending original mine life from nine to 15 years.

headline: ONYX GOLD DRIVES ARGUS NORTH TO 700m DEPTH — 3.5 g/t Au Over 28.1m; New Zone ID'd 250m NE in Timmins Camp (TSXV:ONYX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Onyx Gold Corp.
snippet: Onyx Gold (TSXV: ONYX) confirmed that Argus North at its Munro-Croesus Project in the Timmins Gold Camp, Ontario now extends from near-surface to over 700 metres vertical depth and remains open — highlighted by 3.5 g/t Au over 28.1 metres (including 5.3 g/t over 17.8m) and a separate 19 metres at 3.5 g/t from 409 metres that includes 6.6 metres grading 8.3 g/t. Results from 17 holes also identified a new mineralised trend 250 metres northeast of Argus Main along the projected fault corridor; approximately 35,000 metres remain in the 2026 program.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS OPENS ANTINO NORTHEAST — 58.5m at 1.00 g/t Au; Four Simultaneous Targets in Suriname (TSXV:FDR)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Founders Metals Inc.
snippet: Founders Metals (TSXV: FDR) released a mid-year update across four simultaneously active targets at the Antino Gold Project in southeastern Suriname, with discovery hole ANE009 at Antino Northeast returning 58.5 metres at 1.00 g/t Au from 18.6 metres and a second hole 1,200 metres away intersecting 53.0 metres at 0.46 g/t — demonstrating lateral scale for the new zone. The 70,000-metre, fully-funded 2026 campaign is also advancing Antino North, Antino West (53.1m at 1.21 g/t from surface announced in June), and Maria Geralda simultaneously.

headline: REVIVAL GOLD DRILLS 1.65 g/t AU OVER 30m AT MERCUR — Shallow Heap-Leach Grade Signals PEA Pit Expansion, Utah (TSXV:RVG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Revival Gold Inc.
snippet: Revival Gold (TSXV: RVG) released the first 13 reverse-circulation results from its 2026 drill campaign at the past-producing Mercur Gold Project in Utah — being advanced toward a prefeasibility study — with standout hole RM26-204 returning 30.5 metres at 1.65 g/t Au from 128 metres in the South Mercur area, and hole RM26-183 returning 30.5 metres at 0.92 g/t from 145 metres. The shallow, heap-leachable intercepts represent some of Mercur's highest grades to date and lie outside the current PEA open-pit boundary, pointing to potential resource expansion before PFS.

headline: SOUTHERN CROSS GOLD GOES DEEP AT REDCASTLE — 26.2 g/t Au at 300m Beneath Historic Victorian Goldfield (TSX:SXGC / ASX:SX2)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Southern Cross Gold Ltd.
snippet: Southern Cross Gold (TSX: SXGC / ASX: SX2) reported results from the first-ever deep drilling beneath the historic Redcastle Goldfield in Victoria, Australia, with hole SDDRE016 at the Laura prospect returning 26.2 g/t Au over 0.14 metres from 112.98 metres depth and 15.4 g/t Au over 0.22 metres from 321.84 metres — indicating high-grade gold persisting well below historical underground workings. The results expand Southern Cross's Victorian exploration portfolio beyond its flagship Sunday Creek project and open an untested structural depth target for follow-up drilling.

headline: IRAN WAR MATH FOR COPPER: ANTOFAGASTA -32%, FIRST QUANTUM -55% — Oil at $150 Would Tip Metal Into Surplus Below $10K/t
snippet: A Mining.com analysis models the earnings impact of a sustained US-Iran conflict on major copper producers: Antofagasta earnings fall 32%, First Quantum 55%, and Southern Copper 20% in a scenario where oil holds above $150/barrel, global copper demand growth slows to 0.5-1%, and refined copper tips into a 100,000-200,000 tonne surplus that drives prices below $10,000/tonne. The double shock — Strait of Hormuz disruptions cutting global sulphuric acid supply while a Category 5 storm hit Chile's copper heartland — has already pushed producer unit costs up 10-20% and compressed high-cost margins from roughly 70% to 40%.

headline: EAST BOUGHT GOLD AS WEST SOLD IN H1 — Asia +12.9% vs N. America -15%; Physical Premiums Holding Amid COMEX Selloff (GoldSeek)
snippet: GoldSeek's Asian Metals Market Update for July 15 highlights a defining H1 2026 divergence: gold gained 12.9% during Asian trading sessions while declining more than 15% during North American sessions — a split that reflects persistent demand from Eastern central banks and retail buyers even as COMEX futures were pressured by US-Iran war-driven inflation fears and rate-hike expectations. Shanghai and Singapore physical premiums have remained relatively firm, underscoring that the metal's structural demand story has not broken despite the pullback from January's $5,589 record.
